subject: banshee-haven
q: CLOSED — it is shaped like Bell.
detail: Ghost Haven took the shape of Belladonna's body — warmth, curves, gravity. Specter Haven took Arianna's cock and thighs and stood up. Both houses were built by the land reading the girls who would live in them. The third house spawned the same way, in Arc 13, after Bell and Elspeth. Nothing is recorded about what it grew into, and on the evidence of the first two it will not be an abstraction.
